registration: Tools are registered at runtime via navigator.modelContext.registerTool on page load when the WebMCP API is available.

tools.name: get_office
tools.description: Return BrightWork Realty Advocates office and contact information for Ben Olsen, REALTOR: phone, email, address, DRE, and market tenure.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List all eight BrightWork Realty Advocates program landing pages with a one-line summary and HTTPS URL. Breadth-of-services answer with no MLS data.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Return structured facts about BrightWork's Final Offer offer-management program. Does not return inventory or MLS data.

tools.name: request_consult
tools.description: Submit a contact request to ask whether a home is a Final Offer candidate. Writes contact info to BrightWork's CRM. Contacts only; no CRM read access.
tools.note: Executes in the browser via fub-lead.js against the same bw-fub-proxy endpoint as the human lead form.
